senses.gloss: m. (בִּיזְתָא f.) (בזז, cmp. בְּזִיזֵי; cmp. שׁד̇, שַׁד) feeder, whence pap, breast.
units: Targ. Y. Num. XI, 8 (brisket, v. ביזיאה; h. text לְשַׁד, cmp. שַׁד).—Y. Kil. I, 27ᵇ top ליט ב׳ וכ׳ cursed be the breast which nursed such a man.—Pl. בִּיזַּיָּא.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 21:24">Targ. Job XXI, 24</cite> <he>בִּיזוֹי</he> (Var. <he>תדיוהי</he>).—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:9">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> <he>לייטין ב׳ וכ׳</he>, v. supra; Pesik. Zakh. p. 23ᵇ (Ar. sing.).
